source_semantics.control: The source CurrentUserChip exposes the active site's details destination only when an active site exists.
source_semantics.read_only: The control performs navigation only and does not persist, enqueue, call WordPress, or claim mutation success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/current-user-site-details-control.tsx portals the canonical active-site link into the real .user-chip rendered by AppShell.
laravel_adaptation.active_site_authority: GET /tenants/{tenant}/context already derives active_site from the tenant-scoped canonical_site_id session binding established by the explicit Site Details route and advertises sites.detail.{id} only for that same resolved site.
laravel_adaptation.destination: The control derives /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site} only from FrontendContext tenant.slug plus the authoritative active_site id and requires the exact server-advertised sites.detail.{id} API contract before rendering.
laravel_adaptation.guard: The link fails closed when active_site is absent/invalid, sites.view is absent, or the advertised detail API does not match the active tenant/site.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING operation identity, source, low risk, tenant-owned and non-mutation metadata
production operation marker on the real CurrentUserChip active-site destination
active Site Details route binds canonical_site_id and context returns the same active_site plus exact sites.detail.{id} API
real explicit guarded Site Details workspace and SiteManagementController read API back the destination
guest context is 401, missing sites.view is 403, and foreign site workspace/API access is 404
frontend refuses absent/invalid active site, missing permission, and mismatched tenant API bindings
